title: SecondaryObservabilityVolumeAndSampledCoverageSchemaV3
description: Corrected spatial observability specification explicitly resolving the 20m depth threshold scope (Option A: 36/36 visibility, 9/9 at 20m >= 65 px/m), enforcing OBSERVABILITY_SAMPLE_POINTS terminology, and restricting claims to BOUNDED_SAMPLED_OBSERVABILITY.

spatial_sampling_grid_structure.terminology_standard: OBSERVABILITY_SAMPLE_POINTS (Voxel terminology permanently purged; points represent discrete spatial test locations, not volume elements).

authoritative_resolution_policy.rationale: Only 9 of the 36 sample points are physically located at the 20m depth plane. Asserting that '36/36 points are >= 65 px/m at 20m' is geometrically false. Under optical perspective projection (px/m proportional to 1/d), points closer than 20m naturally exceed 65 px/m. Policy Option A establishes explicit, distinct rules for visibility across all 36 points and spatial resolution at the 20m boundary.

visibility_rule_all_36_points.requirement: Line-of-sight from Camera C unoccluded by permanent structural pillars or fixed infrastructure; SPMT-01 mannequin fully detectable.

resolution_rule_20m_depth_plane.requirement: Target optical pixel density >= 65.0 px/m measured across mannequin torso.

coverage_claims_and_limitations.limitation_statement: Passing the 36-point grid sweep establishes BOUNDED_SAMPLED_OBSERVABILITY along tested line-of-sight rays. Continuous volumetric coverage of the full 70.0 m^2 corridor floor and lateral 0.55m clearance margins (|Y| in [1.2, 1.75] m) remains UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION pending continuous LiDAR surface scanning.

gate_c4_acceptance_rule.rule: Gate C4 PASS requires: (1) visibility_pass_count == 36 AND (2) resolution_pass_count_at_20m == 9 (each >= 65.0 px/m) AND (3) zero surveyed permanent obstructions inside dynamic vehicle diversion path.
